name: SLHS 4245W
title: Neuroscience of Cognitive and Communication Disorders
description: Anatomy and physiology of the central nervous system. Brain mechanisms that underlie speech, language, hearing, and cognition. Neurogenic communication disorders.
requirement_description: SLHS 2203 and 2204; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher. May not be taken out of sequence after passing SLHS 4335.
